plugin.plugin_potatopirates.name: Potato Pirates
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.description: The coding card game Potato Pirates: program your ships with loops and conditions, sink the other crews or collect all 7 Potato Kings. Multiplayer or against bots (easy, medium, hard).
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.setting.king: 7 like the board game; fewer for shorter games.
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.setting.crys: Putting a card on a ship costs crystals: Roast 1, Mash 2, Fry 3, control cards 1. Off: cards are free like in the board game.
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.setting.prom: Frying Dutchpan (the ship keeps its program) and S.S. Megachip (5 cards on a ship) in the deck.
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.setting.shor: When the deck runs out, the player with the most Potato Kings wins.
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.setting.deny: How long players can answer an attack or surprise card with Deny. It closes earlier when everybody let it run.
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.setting.turn: After this time the turn of an absent player ends by itself.
plugin.plugin_potatopirates.node.start.d: Opens a table in the channel: with bots the game starts at once, without a lobby opens.
